component.name: The Awkward Game
component.summary: Adult party game of bluffs, shame and social ruin

description.p: An adult party game about surviving awkward scenarios while your friends judge you. Play solo against AI bots (Chill, Chaotic, Brutal, Honest, Liar) or host multiplayer with a 6-letter room code — friends just open the URL in a browser, no install needed.
